fact: NIRA launched a National ID Registration Initiative for IDPs so they can obtain the National Identity Card, funded by Switzerland and implemented with the Norwegian Refugee Council.
UNDP says a one-month NIRA pilot in Baidoa took mobile ID registration to IDP sites, and expansion to over 3.5 million IDPs nationwide is proposed.
UNDP says the Baidoa pilot registered 38,026 IDPs with biometric technology, against a target of 25,000, and they obtained the national ID.
UNDP says IDPs in Baidoa could enrol in the national ID free of charge, the $5 registration fee being waived.
UNDP says 38,026 IDPs were enrolled in the national ID in Baidoa, of over 500,000 IDPs there.
UNDP says mobile registration reached 38,026 displaced persons within a month at under USD 1 per registration.

The Ministry of Communications and Technology's Digital Inclusion Policy sets out actions to improve connectivity, accessibility and digital skills with specific focus on groups including internally displaced people and refugees.
